index.scope: All Cargo.lock packages, including optional, build, and platform dependencies. This is not a linked-binary inventory. Native engines, the Rust toolchain, fonts, and icons require their separate notices.

limits: All reviewed include declarations are inventoried, including optional metadata whose final linker inclusion is not established.
Only Noto Sans JP and Lucide geometry are bundled; other icon geometry/fonts are acquired separately.
User/project/system assets, optional runtime distributions, and other embedded project code need separate applicability review.
index.scope: Reviewed source declarations and original font/icon notices; final binary linkage and complete legal review are not established.

limits.excluded: System/external headers, Rust toolchain, QuickJS, fonts, icons, and optional runtimes need separate inventories.
limits.recorded_headers: All recorded objects in this build directory, which can include unused or stale targets; missing files are rejected.
limits.source_comments: License/copyright comment candidates in the first 65536 bytes of each observed C/C++/assembly source or header.

review_findings: Chromium BSD terms referenced by source comments require a separate original license; the zlib LICENSE alone is insufficient.
index.scope: Observed Skia build inputs and original notice candidates; binary linkage and complete attribution review are not established.

limits.comments: Comment candidates in the first 65536 bytes of each observed Rust/C/C++/assembly source, not automatic license classifications.
limits.coverage: All installed library sources and library lock registry packages, including unused, optional and test code; compiler executables, system libraries and exact app linkage are excluded.
limits.source_provenance: Local source/target hashes and observed compiler identity; upstream authenticity and source-to-binary provenance require separate verification.
limits.vendor_checksums: Present vendor files are checked against vendor metadata and the library lock. With --cargo-home, original archive checksums and all source hashes are also verified; vendor/archive differences remain explicit review findings. Collection never fetches inputs.
